title: Private tour
text: We had a private tour organised by the company. I’ve used many times in the past, Tour and Travel are excellent at arranging these. The tour guide we had was superb his knowledge of the site, and the time that he gave us was tremendous. I would have no hesitation in recommending both Tour and Travel, and indeed a  private tour.
author: simonaS7118DC

title: A magical experience at Alhambra!
text: My wife and I had an excellent experience with Tour Travel & More, and they were totally professional and honest in every communication.
author: Humsafar168

title: Alhambra and Sacramonte
text: We have been on quite a few privat guided tours in different parts of the world, however none of them have been as informative and well organized as the one with Carmen. She is extremely knowledgeable not only about the Alhambra and it’s history but all of Granada and the culture etc. We had booked 3 hours in the Alhambra and another hour in Sacramonte (4 hours in total) all of which was an amazing experience.
author: 434ibens

title: Excellent guide and driver. Really enjoyed our tour!
text: Our guide,Anna, was amazing. Really enjoyed our tour. She was kind and pleasant and very knowledgeable. The company worked with us to price a driver to drop us at the rain station. Very good communication from the company. They seem very reliable.
author: U6725GZjillw

title: Excellent day with exceptional insights
text: Our guide (Nono) was very knowledgeable and eloquent in his explanation of the various points of interest throughout the tour, taking a gentle pace with calm but clear information not only about Alhambra and all it has to offer but also about Granada and surrounding areas.
author: Richandcas

title: A wonderful experience!
text:
Dear Tour Travel and More,

First, thank you for making it possible for us to have a full private tour at short notice! Carmen was a FANTASTIC guide. Her knowledge of the Alhambra and its history was deep, wide and entertaining as well. We felt her kindness and expertise immediately and came away full of learning and very happy. We would highly recommend her!
author: kimmZ6335BO

title: Fabulous learning experience
text: Our guide arrived earlier than planned, and immediately started touring. He shared amazing info and it was a joy to learn from a true historian.
author: Martha_R

title: Excellent Granada tour
text: Antonio was a great guide, very knowledgeable and kept everything at the right pace. His interest in the Alhambra was infectious and we left with a much greater understanding of the various periods of change.
author: Janice R

title: The Sultan of Sites
text: Our guide was knowledgable and understood how to manage the pace with a family of five. He also wove in legends of the site that kept our kids more engaged. Alhamba has to be one of the most beautiful sites in the entire world - the Sultan’s palace is a stunning work of architecture and design. The guide and the site should be on everyone’s shortlist.
author: Katie_A

title: Excellent
text: It was an incredible afternoon, not only because of the place that catches you because of its beauty and haunting leaves you speechless, the help of guide Antonio was essential as well, his way of telling , of feeling and putting passion to the story made the tour incredibly short.Thank you Antonio for so good doing it is nice to find people like that.
author: katyastur
